message: Function has multiple exit doors — use b_continue pattern

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' has {count} exit doors — use b_continue pattern

rationale: Multiple exit points create invisible control flow. A reviewer must trace every path to understand what the function returns. A single exit makes the return value the function's explicit contract.
remediation: Refactor to use b_continue pattern with one return at the end of the function.

guidance.explanation: The correct version uses b_continue to gate execution and a single return at the end. The incorrect version has multiple return statements, making control flow harder to trace.
